newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia computer firm Pennu issue completed.
newsitem.headline: Estonia computer firm Pennu issue completed.

text.p: The second and final part of a share issue by Estonian computer firm Pennu has been completed and was oversubscribed, broker Cresco Securities said on Monday.

The second part of the offer targeted local institutional investors and the public and comprised 108,718 shares at 43 kroons each. Cresco said in a statement that the issue was oversubcribed by 3.5 times.

The first part of the offer was completed on July 26 and was aimed at international investors. Institutions from the U.S., U.K. and Scandinavia took part. The total offer aimed at raising 6.88 million kroons.
Pennu makes computers from the components of other manufacturers and resells them in the Baltics.
It recently signed an agreement with Western Digital WCD.N to build a hard disk repair facility to service eastern Europe.
Pennu's pre-tax profit was 4.3 million kroons in 1995.
Pennu plans to list its shares on the secondary list of the Tallinn stock exchange.
